text:
anna li: Quick check — are we still on for the SOC2 control matrix handoff tomorrow? I have the export from KMS owners but need final signoff.

mike r.: Yep, still on. I pushed the keystore mapping to the doc a few minutes ago: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/keystore-mapping

jessicah: I skimmed — small gap on `audit.log.rotate` retention calc. Sam, can you confirm current retention on staging KMS?

sam-eng: Staging retention is 90 days by default. For KMS logs we have ~400GB/day estimate; retention will need to be 365 for prod. I'll add numbers to the sheet.

anna li: Thanks. @ashley-okta can you confirm HSM attestation window? Auditor asked for evidence of monthly attestations.

ashley-okta: We run an automated attestation job on the 1st of the month; last run had a flaky result due to network timeouts. Filed ticket: GH#4587. We're re-running tonight.

mike r.: GH#4587 — noted. If it flakes again, we should fallback to manual attestation and attach signed PDF to evidence bucket. @security-bot can you remind us about evidence naming convention?

security-bot: Reminder: evidence files must use pattern `org_env_control_evidence_YYYYMMDD` and be uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/attestations

jessicah: For the `auditlog` pipeline, one more dependency — eng-infra needs to confirm log-forwarder schema change won't break ingestion. @sam-eng can you loop them in?

sam-eng: Looping in infra now. FYI I'm dropping a small config patch: 
```yaml
forwarder:
  include_kms_context: true
```
Should be backward compatible.

anna li: Good. Final ask — can owners list be frozen by EOD so I can start packaging evidence? I'll tag in the control matrix.

mike r.: I'll freeze my rows. @ashley-okta say if attestation rerun succeeds, otherwise we'll mark manual evidence.

ashley-okta: Rerun succeeded, uploading to bucket. Link: s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/attestations/ashley-okta_20260317.pdf :thumbsup: 

jessicah: Thanks all. Closing loop on the retention numbers and mapping doc. I'll post the final matrix here in an hour.

anna li: Perfect — thanks team :raised_hands:
